name: Bulgaria (presidential)
notes: President of Bulgaria: first round held 25 October 2026; runoff Iotova vs Gyurov on 1 November. CIK first-round result is 100% counted. The runoff model anchors on the actual first-round two-way vote, the single pre-round Sova Harris head-to-head poll, a 40%-weight eliminated-candidate transfer prior, and a +1.5pp GERB/SDS endorsement scenario (range 0.5-2.5pp); exit polls are validation-only and excluded from averages and pollster MAE.

turnout.source: Historical CIK presidential turnout; postmortem actual 21.91
